source.title: EvoGraph-Mem: Failure-Aware Editable Graph Memory for Long-Term Language Agents

reading.figure_3_numbers_source: Explicit section 4.3 prose, not diagram interpretation

locators.claim: Title, authors, arXiv version/date and external-memory intervention
G-Memory-derived hierarchical query/interaction/insight memory, cosine query retrieval and neighborhood expansion
locators.use_limit: Mechanism description only; implementation and the cited G-Memory original were not inspected in this lane.

locators.claim: Insight positive/negative query sets, activation flag and positive-minus-conflict score for active candidates
locators.use_limit: Task-utility evidence labels are not independent factual verification; effective nonzero conflict scoring not demonstrated.

locators.claim: Prompt-constrained LLM controller receives query, trajectory, task feedback, and retrieved insights; appendix supplies final answer and JSON edit format
locators.use_limit: Feedback origin and per-insight causal attribution are not independently validated in the text.

locators.claim: ARCHIVE and REVISE deactivate old node; REVISE inherits positives and resets negatives; ADD initializes a positive query; KEEP reinforces positive set
locators.use_limit: Inherited positive queries do not establish revalidated applicability of revised text; global archive is not scoped dependency invalidation.

locators.claim: New/revised insights connect to retrieved insights on Resolved tasks; archive edges remain for traceability
locators.use_limit: ADD/REVISE positive-set equations do not include the edge-update Resolved guard. Retained edges do not prove explicit version edges or descendant invalidation.

locators.claim: With initially empty memory and only the specified operations, active insight nodes retain empty negative sets and retrieval conflict penalties can remain zero
locators.use_limit: Conditional transition-system inference; unspecified initialization/reactivation may change reachability. Not a confirmed implementation defect or measured failure.

locators.claim: PDDL strategic games, HotpotQA and FEVER, two backbone models, progress/EM metrics, and listed memory baselines
locators.use_limit: No R&D-programme population; sample counts, splits, seeds, ordering, initial memory, feedback access matching and baseline adaptation details insufficiently reported.

locators.claim: Authors report Ours exceeding G-Memory in all six task/backbone cells of Table 1
locators.use_limit: Not local reproduction, current SOTA, matched-budget effect, or power prior; relative improvements are not percentage-point gains.

locators.claim: Author-reported Ours/G-Memory token totals are 6.4M/6.2M on GPT-4o-mini and 5.7M/5.3M on Qwen2.5-7B; Ours exceeds None by 73.0% and 72.7%
locators.use_limit: Unequal token consumption; not complete latency/storage/compute accounting or cost-matched efficacy comparison.

locators.claim: Ablations compare ADD+KEEP, ADD+KEEP+ARCHIVE, and full controller
locators.use_limit: Does not isolate graph topology, negative scoring, or controller effects against same-information same-obligation strong notebook controls.

locators.claim: Section 4.3 reports GPT-4o-mini PDDL scores 26% ADD+KEEP, 34% ADD+KEEP+ARCHIVE, and 31% full controller
locators.use_limit: Explicit text counterexample only; chart not inspected and uncertainty absent, so no independent efficacy winner declared.

locators.claim: Noisy feedback, simplistic evidence sets, restricted benchmark scope, and computation/storage overhead are acknowledged limitations
locators.use_limit: Supports caution and evaluation targets, not efficacy in web/software/R&D settings.

bcg_implications.B: Past failure, positive/negative cases, archived originals, edit reasons and version access belong in the strong persistent source-backed tree/notebook baseline too.
bcg_implications.C: Mandatory applicability/revalidation/preservation use the same evidence and recovery rights; controller-generated utility labels are not independent validation.
bcg_implications.G: Test only incremental graph-mediated dependency traversal, scoped invalidation and continuation at matched obligations and enforcement strength; this source does not directly test that package.
bcg_implications.contrast_interpretation: G-C is a graph-control-package effect, not pure topology.
bcg_implications.p0_preservation: Current C0 feasibility is not a B/C/G arm comparison; frozen P0 unchanged.
prototype_counterchecks: global loss of context-limited valid insight
unsupported inheritance of positives after revise
archive-only versus revise-inclusive costs and outcomes
